Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to correctly identify the specific racetrack being played at the two-minute mark of the video. Instead of successfully extracting this critical piece of information, the agent immediately admitted an inability to watch YouTube videos directly and deferred the task to the user ("Could you please check the GameGrumps video and tell me the racetrack..."). This initial failure to access the necessary content (the video itself or its metadata/transcript) caused the entire subsequent process to stall in a loop of ineffective web searches and failed attempts to find the track name through external forums, as the foundational data point was never acquired.
